messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Spike in 5xx and streaming disconnects on /v1/stream (eu-west) — gateway-level errors and client cancellations detected. Please ack and triage.

Priya (oncall-sre): acked. pulling dashboards now. seeing sharp rise starting 03:12:40Z.

Priya (oncall-sre): symptom summary: many clients report partial chunks then abrupt connection close. Gateway logs show `522 origin_timeout` and occasional `502` with no chunk-trailer. Global error-rate 2.8% but eu-west ~6.5%.

Lukas (eng-runtime): will investigate runtime; any recent model or binary rollouts?

Ethan (eng-platform): no app deploys. autoscaling events: autoscale-bot reports transient LB rebinds around 03:13:00Z but no instance terminations.

Nora (eng-infra): collecting host-level metrics. initial finding: elevated TCP retransmit and a burst of SYN-ACK retries for hosts servicing eu-west edge. NAT gateway logs show flapping sessions.

Priya (oncall-sre): immediate mitigations proposal: 1) reduce streaming concurrency at gateway to reduce pressure, 2) temporarily increase streaming idle/proxy timeouts, 3) enable streaming fallback to paginated polling for non-premium customers, 4) capture full tcpdump and trace bundles for failed request ids.

Lukas (eng-runtime): repro attempt from eu-west LB:
```
$ curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"stream test"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (10.5.2.11) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
> Transfer-Encoding: chunked
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Transfer-Encoding: chunked
{ partial chunk data... }
* server closed connection unexpectedly
* Curl error: 56 (Recv failure: Connection reset by peer)
```
Observing connection accepted then closed mid-stream, no trailing CRLF chunk.

Ethan (eng-platform): checking gateway proxy (envoy+nginx hybrid). Current keepalive probes low, proxy idle_timeout=30s. I'll bump to 90s and add extra TCP keepalive probes for upstream.

Nora (eng-infra): on hosts ip-10-4-21-9 and ip-10-4-21-10 kernel shows retransmit queue spikes and TCP_RTO. Scheduling temporary traffic shift off those hosts.

Priya (oncall-sre): applying mitigation: set gateway_stream_limit=1200 (was 3500) to relieve head-of-line.

deploy-bot: Config change requested by Priya: `gateway_stream_limit=1200`. Rolling to gateway nodes gw-a, gw-b, gw-c.

deploy-bot: roll started -> gw-a,gw-b,gw-c.

Lukas (eng-runtime): enabling compatibility-mode in routing: if streaming request returns 5xx or early close, gateway will rewrite to `?mode=paged` and replay for non-streaming clients for up to 20s. Patching router now.

Ethan (eng-platform): applied `proxy_read_timeout 90s` and bumped `upstream_keepalive_probes` to 5 for streaming routes. Pushing to prod.

Nora (eng-infra): migrated traffic away from the two noisy hosts; NAT gateway sessions stabilized. Kernel retransmits dropped ~70%.

Lukas (eng-runtime): digging deeper in runtime traces — found rare panic triggered by concurrent kv-cache resize under heavy streaming churn leading to abrupt connection termination (~0.2% of requests). Opening runtime fix branch to serialize eviction and add safe-checks.

Lukas (eng-runtime): temporary runtime-side mitigation: enable kv-serialize=true on eu-west runtime pool to prevent concurrent eviction races. Rolling one node at a time.

deploy-bot: runtime config `kv_serialize=true` applied to pool runtime-eu-west (5 nodes). Rolling restarts in progress.

Priya (oncall-sre): monitoring metrics: eu-west 5xx rate dropped from 6.5% -> 1.0% in 8 minutes after combined infra+gateway+runtime mitigations. Global streaming client disconnects also trending down.

Taylor (product): Customer impact: two enterprise customers and several SMBs reported truncated streams; support has open tickets. CS-Bot please update.

CS-Bot: Created ticket C-12899 for BetaApps and C-12900 for BrightMedia. Notifying account teams and drafting status note.

Priya (oncall-sre): next recommended steps for follow-up: 1) postmortem with kernel tcpdump and runtime traces 2) make proxy_read_timeout change permanent for streaming route 3) add synthetic streaming healthcheck probe from eu-west every 30s 4) runtime patch to avoid kv eviction race (PR required).

Lukas (eng-runtime): will open issue runtime-805 with reproducer, logs, and patch plan. Uploading trace bundle to s3://redwood-incidents/2469004321/trace_bundle.tar.gz

Ethan (eng-platform): also recommend implementing a short retry-with-backoff in gateway for chunked streams that close with 5xx before first full token is emitted.

Priya (oncall-sre): handing off to Lukas for code + post-incident follow-ups in 30m. I'll remain reachable for customer escalations.

Lukas (eng-runtime): acknowledged handoff. I'll take lead on the postmortem and coordinate with infra for kernel-level remediation.

autoscale-bot: No autoscaler activity during incident window apart from LB rebind events.

deploy-bot: All config rolls completed successfully.

Priya (oncall-sre): status -> MONITORING. Error rates reduced and mitigations applied. Keep incident thread open for postmortem notes.

Taylor (product): I'll coordinate a brief customer update once we confirm runtime PR merge and schedule a follow-up: ETA for full fix ~48h.

Lukas (eng-runtime): attaching list of reproducer request IDs and tcpdump filenames to runtime-805. Closing live triage.
